sanskrit_verse: पूर्वपक्षे प्रतिज्ञातम् अशेषं प्रतिभावयेत् । ऊनाधिकं तु यत्रोक्तं न तन् निगदितं भवेत् ॥
transliteration: pūrvapakṣe pratijñātam aśeṣaṃ pratibhāvayet | ūnādhikaṃ tu yatroktaṃ na tan nigaditaṃ bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the prior stance, whatever has been declared must be fully actualized; that which is spoken as deficient or excessive is not to be reiterated.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in complete enactment, not partial assertion.
Causation arises from full manifestation, not speculative excess.
Capacity-based responsibility demands alignment with declared completeness.
Restoration logic requires cessation of redundant or exaggerated declarations.
Consciousness alignment occurs through precise fulfillment, not repetitive assertion.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a declaration is made by authorized consciousness AND it remains unactualized, THEN initiate completion protocol.
IF a statement exceeds or falls short of enacted reality, THEN suppress its repetition in legal discourse.
IF responsibility is tied to capacity, THEN measure fulfillment by ontological congruence, not verbal volume.
IF restoration is required, THEN discontinue amplification of defective or surplus assertions.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, any judicial pronouncement must reflect total actualization of declared dharma. Redundant or exaggerated claims—whether from deficit or excess—must not be entertained or repeated, as they distort the pramāṇa-field necessary for pure adjudication.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyāya operates through pramāṇa-based causality: only what is fully declared and realized holds causal weight. Repetition of deficient or inflated statements disrupts sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility aligns with capacity to enact, not to amplify. Thus, dharma corrects through clarity, not through correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Full Actualization Review to ensure declared truths are ontologically completed.
Deploy Redundancy Suppression Protocols to prevent reiteration of incomplete or excessive claims.
Engage Consciousness Congruence Calibration to realign declarer's intent with manifested outcome.
Activate Clarity Restoration Field to dissolve distortion caused by surplus or deficit utterances.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator. All declarations find completion in alignment with the Whole.
